observations.title: New county-matched weather outlook
observations.sourceScope: Regional NWS forecast; no observed Watershed disruption.
observations.finding: The relevant Illinois zone group covers all three known Illinois operating-presence counties. The separate southern Illinois heat-advisory zone is not attributed to these facilities.
observations.decision: Recheck local warnings and route conditions before shifts and dispatch.

observations.title: Pet-supplement ingredient recall discovery
observations.sourceScope: FDA-hosted company announcement; source publication precedes today.
observations.finding: Fi recalled dog supplements after a supplied ingredient raised potential Salmonella concerns.
observations.decision: Quality may compare applicable materials and supplier controls. A Watershed relationship or affected material is not established; do not treat this as a Watershed recall.

observations.title: Cashew-inclusion hard-material recall discovery
observations.sourceScope: Specific So Delicious frozen-dessert recall, not the whole cashew market.
observations.finding: The company reported the potential presence of stones or other hard material in cashew inclusions in one recalled frozen-dessert product.
observations.decision: Use as a foreign-material control review lead for relevant nut inclusions only. No Watershed supplier, manufacturing or customer connection is established.

observations.title: Historical company litigation notice discovered
observations.sourceScope: Administrator notice, not a current docket disposition.
observations.finding: See company-ground-truth claim F27. The notice’s scheduled approval hearing has elapsed, while the page still uses conditional language.
observations.decision: HR/legal should verify the current disposition. Do not infer liability, final approval, payment or a new incident.

observations.title: New KEV records await installed-inventory matching
observations.sourceScope: CISA catalog additions; no installed Watershed systems identified.
observations.finding: Recent vendor vulnerability records were collected successfully.
observations.decision: Authorized IT staff must match vendor, product and version before estimating company exposure. An empty company match is not a cyber clearance.

observations.title: Ingredient benchmarks diverge: grains up, dairy down
observations.sourceScope: Reference August 2026; July-to-August changes. Preliminary. Oilseeds are not a pumpkin-seed quote; grains are not a food-grade popcorn quote.
observations.finding: August BLS PPI: grains +4.3% and oilseeds +3.9% month over month (SA); dairy products -1.0% (NSA). These broad benchmarks cannot be netted into a Watershed cost change without actual purchasing weights.
observations.decision: Compare the next quotes for grain, seed and dairy categories separately; quantify net effect only after purchasing weights are supplied.

observations.title: Metro labor context remains mixed
observations.sourceScope: Reference July 2026, preliminary and not seasonally adjusted. Exact release day unverified; retrieved September 17. Monthly declines can be seasonal.
observations.finding: July preliminary NSA unemployment: Bloomington 3.3% (June 4.0%), Peoria 3.8% (4.5%), Milwaukee-Waukesha 3.8% (3.8%). Bloomington and Peoria manufacturing employment was 1.2% and 0.9% below a year earlier. This does not establish a Watershed shortage.
observations.decision: Use metro data to frame a hiring review; compare it with actual recruiting results before changing staffing or pay assumptions.

observations.title: Latest industrial electricity benchmark is higher year over year
observations.sourceScope: Reference June 2026; comparison June 2025. Released August 26; next EIA release scheduled September 24. Lagged data does not describe today’s spot rate.
observations.finding: EIA June industrial prices: Illinois 10.65 cents/kWh versus 9.65 a year earlier (+10.4%); Wisconsin 9.95 versus 9.62 (+3.4%). These are preliminary state averages, not Watershed tariffs or bills.
observations.decision: Finance and operations should compare actual effective cents/kWh and process energy use with plan; prioritize measured efficiency opportunities.

observations.title: Packaging signals split between paperboard and plastics
observations.sourceScope: Reference August 2026, preliminary. Annual and monthly changes are separate; the film series includes non-food shapes. Paperboard API is the same economic series, not independent corroboration.
observations.finding: August PPI: paperboard +2.3% month over month (NSA) and +5.1% year over year; plastic resins -0.8% (SA); unsupported plastic film, sheet, and other shapes -0.5% (NSA), still +12.5% year over year. These categories are broader than food packaging.
observations.decision: Separate carton and film quote reviews; request evidence for index-linked adjustments rather than applying a blended packaging inflation rate.

observations.title: Global CPG proxy retains cautious sales outlook
observations.sourceScope: Fiscal 2027 guidance is an external company forecast, not Watershed revenue guidance. Next quarterly release is scheduled September 23; no future result is assumed.
observations.finding: General Mills reaffirmed fiscal 2027 organic net sales guidance of -1.5% to +0.5% on September 8. Management described improving retail trends and innovation response. This is one archetype observation, not evidence of Watershed customer orders or category-wide growth.
observations.decision: Sales should map verified customer briefs to freeze-dried, baked, roasted and popped capabilities, and review the September 23 earnings update when published.

observations.title: EIA’s export-constraint scenario supports a fuel watch
observations.sourceScope: EIA forecast completed September 3 and released September 9. Projected inventories and export constraints are attributed scenarios, not realized measurements. No own forecast probability is created.
observations.finding: EIA’s September outlook assumes Middle East export constraints through year-end and forecasts tight distillate inventories. This provides a conditional explanation for fuel exposure already tracked in S01, not a second independent loss estimate.
observations.decision: Use the same logistics/finance review as S01; run a conditional fuel-surcharge sensitivity instead of issuing a separate geopolitical alarm.

reviewNotes: Intelligence: separated retrieval dates from publication and event dates; no inferred supplier/customer links.
Operations research: six additional domains now have reviewed conditional benchmarks; Cyber / OT remains null. Price proxies are not actual spend, and the same fuel mechanism is not counted twice.
Supply chain: fuel surcharges and truck dependence remain contract-dependent assumptions.
Industrial engineering: county outlook does not establish plant interruption, exact Top Fox production allocation or Wisconsin site exposure.
Food science/quality: sector recalls were retained as verification leads without asserting contaminated Watershed inputs or relaxing safety controls.
Information security: KEV additions require authorized inventory matching; no installed products inferred.
Continuity: outlooks are not warnings; actual applicable emergencies require approved response and explicit escalation.

Coverage review: guarded parsers preserve units, release/reference periods, SA/NSA footnotes, exact series and preliminary status. A 403 response remains blocked despite a successful manual primary-source read.
Company evidence: Illinois roasting language does not prove Gridley site allocation. Public Paycom recruiting links do not prove internal payroll/ERP use.
Demand review: General Mills is an archetype proxy only. Its external guidance and EIA scenarios are attributed forecasts; no Watershed customer or self-scored forecast is created.
Quality review: human supplement Part 111 scope must not be silently applied to pet products; FDA states DSHEA does not create an animal dietary-supplement category.

Geographic review: OSM markers are municipality references, Milwaukee is not the confirmed plant city, and mapped corridors do not establish actual routes or rail use. All 15 facility input/equipment models remain INFERRED with alternatives and verification steps.
baselineNote: First dated assessment. No yesterday or 30/90/365-day backfill; older evidence is not a newly occurring event.

materialChanges: Added six conditional benchmark assessments S08–S13
Added explicit facility best guesses and OSM geographic context
rechecks.note: Coverage expansion is not a newly occurring deterioration. Overall score remains 47; Cyber / OT remains unassessed. No forecast resolved.

executiveSummary: The leading scored pressure remains Midwest diesel: verify actual carrier surcharges and pass-through. Coverage now includes ingredient costs, packaging, industrial energy, metro labor, a global CPG demand proxy and the fuel-related geopolitical channel. Mixed benchmark signals should be checked against quotes and contracts before acting. Cyber remains unassessed pending authorized inventory matching. The additional coverage does not establish a new Watershed disruption or a rise in overall posture.
